* Legend

- IP: the initial page, before any button. FRP: the final rendered page (our table).
- States: yes: Works; part: Works for some of the page's links only; no: No preview; na: Does not apply (no such page part).
- Evidence: spec: A fixture spec asserts it; `spec` names the file and a test-title substring; code: Read from the code; no spec asserts it; inferred: Believed from the code's shape, not traced to the end.
- 2b cells: H opens in the window (Back returns), T new tab, T! new tab and a gap, - no such window there.
  A plain left click; Ctrl, Shift, Alt, ⌘ or the middle button always keep the new tab.

* 2a Link families the preview reads

_EXT_READERS, first match wins. "Any window": its links open in place in every window.
"All links": every link a reader takes opens in place in its own window.

| #  | Reader      | Links it reads                                                                                                                               | Asks                                  | Its window                                | Any window | All links |
|----+-------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+------------+-----------|
| 1  | youtube     | youtube.com/watch?v=…, youtu.be/<id>, /shorts/, /playlist?list=…                                                                             | www.youtube.com (oEmbed)              | Play here tile                            | -          | -         |
| 2  | wikipedia   | <lang>.wikipedia.org/wiki/<title>                                                                                                            | <lang>.wikipedia.org                  | Infobox, opening, sections                | -          | yes       |
| 3  | wikidata    | www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q<n>                                                                                                                   | www.wikidata.org, query.wikidata.org  | Statements, identifiers, articles         | -          | yes       |
| 4  | dgimages    | discogs.com/release/<id>/images, …/images/update                                                                                             | www.discogs.com (with cookies)        | Window only: every image                  | -          | -         |
| 5  | dghistory   | discogs.com/(release¦master¦artist¦label)/<id>/history                                                                                       | www.discogs.com                       | Window only: every change and its diff    | -          | -         |
| 6  | discogs     | discogs.com/(release¦master¦artist¦label)/<id>                                                                                               | api.discogs.com (+ token)             | The record, versions, credits             | -          | -         |
| 7  | dguser      | discogs.com/user/<name>                                                                                                                      | api.discogs.com, www.discogs.com      | Profile, recent activity                  | -          | -         |
| 8  | dgsearch    | discogs.com/search/?q=…&type=…                                                                                                               | api.discogs.com                       | 25 results, Load 25 more                  | -          | -         |
| 9  | dgsupport   | support.discogs.com/hc/<lang>/articles/<id>                                                                                                  | support.discogs.com                   | The article                               | -          | -         |
| 10 | bbdate      | brucebase.wikidot.com/<yyyy>#<ddmmyy>                                                                                                        | brucebase.wikidot.com (the year page) | The show from its year page               | yes        | -         |
| 11 | springsteen | SL item and song pages, jungleland.it/html/<x>.htm, brucespringsteen.it detrec.aspx, Brucebase /song: (and /gig:, /venue:, … on discogs.com) | the link's own host                   | The site's page, parsed                   | yes        | -         |
| 12 | setlistfm   | setlist.fm /setlist/…, /setlists/…, /venue/… (with the key); /search?artist=… (always)                                                       | api.setlist.fm (key), www.setlist.fm  | The setlist, the artist's or venue's list | yes        | yes       |
| 13 | iadetails   | archive.org/details/<id>[/<file>]                                                                                                            | archive.org (/metadata)               | The item, its files, Play here            | yes        | -         |

** Notes

- n1: On its own site a detail link opens in the site's own window; it needs that site's preview switch (Brucebase shows also sa_bb_event_preview).
- n2: Needs sa_pop_mb (Preview linked entities on hover). Off musicbrainz.org it is MusicBrainz's window read from the other site (dg-mb): its Web Service request anonymous, its Live page and editing history with the browser's musicbrainz.org cookies (vzell's consent: discogs.com and setlist.fm, then on 2026-11-03 the Springsteen sites and archive.org).
- n3: setlist, artist and venue pages need sa_pop_ext_setlistfm_key; without it only /search?artist= is read, and on setlist.fm itself the others keep their new tab.
- n4: On discogs.com a Discogs page no reader takes is the site's own link and keeps its new tab.
- n5: Brucebase's own reader, under sa_bb_event_preview; with it off, the generic reader's (then here only in a window that opens every link).

** Windows

- MusicBrainz entity: mb-entity on musicbrainz.org; dg-mb on every other site (_MB_FOREIGN_POP_HOST; the Springsteen sites and archive.org since 2026-11-03)
- Discogs (6 readers): discogs, dguser, dgsearch, dgsupport, dghistory, dgimages: onAreaClick → _extDgDrill()
- Wikipedia: allLinksReaders
- Wikidata: allLinksReaders
- setlist.fm: allLinksReaders
- Springsteen detail: the springsteen reader, or the site's own window on its own host
- Brucebase show (year#date): the bbdate reader; also the MB-Event glyph's window
- archive.org item: the iadetails reader
- YouTube: the youtube reader
- Other web page: the generic reader

* Gaps

None open. Gaps found and fixed are recorded in org/non-MB-coverage.org.
